    "capacity",

    r."id",
    r."name",
    r."address",
    r."food_service",
    r."cuisine"
FROM
    "restaurants" r
WHERE
    r."food_service" = 'cafe'
    AND LOWER(r."cuisine") LIKE '%italian%'

UNION ALL

SELECT
    r."id",
    r."name",
    r."address",
    r."food_service",
    r."cuisine"
FROM
    "restaurants" r
WHERE
    r."food_service" != 'cafe'
    OR r."food_service" IS NULL;

SELECT
    its."id" AS specialist_id,
    its."name" AS specialist_name,
    string_agg(s."system_name", ', ' ORDER BY s."system_name") AS systems
FROM
    "it_support_specialists" its
LEFT JOIN
    "it_support_specialists_systems" itss ON its."id" = itss."it_specialist_id"
LEFT JOIN
    "systems" s ON itss."system_id" = s."system_id"
GROUP BY
    its."id", its."name"
ORDER BY
    its."name";
110:
SELECT
    its.id AS it_specialist_id,
    its.name AS it_specialist_name,
    s.system_name,
    s.is_active
FROM
    it_support_specialists its
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
        s.system_name,
        s.is_active
    FROM
        it_support_specialists_systems itss
    JOIN
        systems s ON itss.system_id = s.system_id
    WHERE
        itss.it_specialist_id = its.id
) s;

112:
WITH responsibility_counts AS (
    SELECT
        r."responsibility",
        COUNT(DISTINCT ir."internshipid") AS internship_count
    FROM
        "responsibilities" r
    JOIN
        "internships_responsibilities" ir ON r."id" = ir."responsibilityid"
    GROUP BY
        r."responsibility"
),
total_internships AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM "internships"
)
SELECT
    rc."responsibility"
FROM
    responsibility_counts rc
CROSS JOIN
    total_internships ti
WHERE
    rc.internship_count = ti.total;

266:
SELECT
    j."minimum_years" AS minimum_experience_years,
    j."preferred_years" AS preferred_experience_years,
    j."jobtitle" AS position_title,
    j."description" AS position_description,
    STRING_AGG(rs."skillname", ', ' ORDER BY rs."skillname") AS required_skills,
    STRING_AGG(er."degreelevel" || ' in ' || er."fieldofstudy", ', ' ORDER BY er."degreelevel") AS education_requirements
FROM
    "jobs" j
LEFT JOIN
    "jobskills" js ON j."jobid" = js."jobid"
LEFT JOIN
    "requiredskills" rs ON js."skillid" = rs."skillid"
LEFT JOIN
    "jobeducation" je ON j."jobid" = je."jobid"
LEFT JOIN
    "educationrequirements" er ON je."requirementid" = er."requirementid"
WHERE
    j."salary" = (SELECT MAX("salary") FROM "jobs" WHERE "salary" IS NOT NULL)
GROUP BY
    j."jobid", j."minimum_years", j."preferred_years", j."jobtitle", j."description";
